description: Use this when you need a wallet's first SOL funder and whether other wallets look like the same operator. Find a wallet's first SOL funder, flag wallets that share that funder or a CEX deposit address, and return a cluster id with plain-language sybil risk reasons. Labeled exchange hot wallets are not used as a cluster. Optional peers compares up to 8 other wallets. Costs $0.009 USDC (9000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /wallet/funding. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.

address.description: Solana wallet address in base58 (32 to 44 characters). Example: HD1ryR3dYSXBVNGfJZydbpmnChiE1wrAQkupWWtHt4pM

peers.description: Comma-separated peer wallets, up to 8. Do not repeat the primary address.
